name: Master Linguist
body:
Prerequisite(s) Linguistics 5 ranks, Perform (oratory) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): From this point forward, whenever you put a rank into Perform (oratory), you learn to speak and read a new language. You do not learn any languages for ranks put into Perform (oratory) before gaining this feat.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
